description: Next Generation Liquefaction (NGL) Database - Data Tables is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kristin Ulmer, Southwest Research Institute (swri.org). The Next Generation Liquefaction (NGL) Database (Ulmer et al. 2023, DOI: 10.21222/C23P70) collects and organizes liquefaction information to provide all researchers with a consistent and reliable source of liquefaction data. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-cpfr-c782. Keywords: liquefaction, earthquake, data tables. Published 2026-08-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
